head_commit.message:
Protect fork history references during rollout cleanup (#34566)

## Why

Paginated forks can retain a `history_base` pointer to another rollout. Deleting or compressing either side of that relationship can leave the fork without the rollout history it references.

## What changed

- Add a rollout reference index that scans active, archived, and compressed rollout metadata.
- Reject deletion when a rollout is still referenced by a fork outside the requested deletion set.
- Delete spawned thread subtrees as one store operation so internal references do not block deleting the complete subtree, while external references preflight the request before any files are removed.
- Skip referenced rollouts, fork-pointer rollouts, and rollouts with unreadable metadata during background compression.

## Testing

- Cover reference indexing across active, archived, compressed, duplicate, and self-referencing rollouts.
- Verify deletion rejects external references without partially deleting a subtree and permits batch deletion of internally referenced threads.
- Verify compression preserves fork pointer chains and continues past unreadable metadata.

head_commit.message:
Preserve status for evicted V2 agents

V2 residency eviction removes idle agents from ThreadManager while
leaving their logical identities in AgentRegistry. Status queries
therefore report NotFound for completed and errored agents after
eviction, even though callers can still address those agents.

When eviction removes the expected CodexThread, retain its bounded
terminal status in the matching AgentMetadata. Under the ThreadManager
write lock, publish the status only if the registry still contains the
same metadata generation. This makes the status available before the
matching removal becomes visible without publishing through a stale
metadata handle.

Tie each cached status to its CodexThread source. Reloaded threads clear
the cache, and status reads reject a cache from another CodexThread.

Limit cached text to 128 bytes because status can enter model-visible
tool output. Keep existing behavior for interrupted agents and for
Missing or Replaced removals, where eviction did not remove the
captured thread.
